requirements.Decimal precision: pin local Decimal Context precision, e.g. precision 50 or other justified fixed value
requirements.canonical stored precision: store canonical calculation outputs at declared significant-digit/decimal-place policy; enough for deterministic reproduction but not false evidentiary accuracy
requirements.contract_fingerprint: fingerprint all method parameters excluding the fingerprint field itself
requirements.deterministic_serialization: canonical JSON sort_keys=True, compact separators, UTF-8, no timestamps inside fingerprints
requirements.human_display_precision: separate display policy from canonical stored values
requirements.input canonicalization: Decimal from canonical base-10 strings only; reject exponent/locale/binary floats unless explicitly normalized
requirements.local context: all Decimal division, summation, variance, sqrt, and formatting execute inside localcontext(fixed_context)
requirements.mean algorithm: sum observed Decimal values / observed_count inside pinned context
requirements.median algorithm: sort observed Decimal values; odd middle/even average inside pinned context
requirements.rounding mode: pin local rounding mode, e.g. ROUND_HALF_EVEN, serialized exactly
requirements.scientific_notation_policy: define whether scientific notation is forbidden or allowed only under thresholds
requirements.square-root algorithm: use Decimal.sqrt fixed context or define Newton iteration with termination and rounding; serialize chosen implementation
requirements.summation order: stable entity_id, indicator_code, period ordering before arithmetic
requirements.trailing_zero_normalization: define normalized string form and whether trailing zeros are stripped
